form.label: Link to your Letterboxd list
form.help: Paste the link to a public list, or a boxd.it short link. On Android, you can also share the list from the Letterboxd app.

errors.invalid_url: This link doesn’t lead to a Letterboxd list. It must contain /list/ or be a boxd.it short link to a list.
errors.list_not_found: List not found. Check that it still exists and is public.
errors.empty: This list is empty. Add films on Letterboxd, then come back.
errors.letterboxd_unavailable: Letterboxd isn’t responding right now. Try again in a few minutes.
errors.tmdb_not_configured: The TMDB key isn’t configured on the server (NUXT_TMDB_TOKEN variable).
errors.unknown: Couldn’t load the list. Check your connection and try again.

loading.title: Dealing the tickets…
loading.note: The first time a list opens takes about ten seconds. After that it’s almost instant.

data.title: Film data
data.tmdb: Posters, runtimes, genres and synopses come from The Movie Database (TMDB).
data.letterboxd: Lists are read from public Letterboxd pages. This site is not affiliated with or endorsed by Letterboxd. Letterboxd is a trademark of Letterboxd Limited.
data.posters: Posters remain the property of their respective rights holders.

privacy.title: Personal data
privacy.body: No account, no analytics, no advertising cookies. Only these settings are kept, and only on your phone:
privacy.list: the link to the last list you opened, so you don’t have to paste it again;
privacy.draw: the current draw (the list, the drawn tickets, the chosen film and the length filter), forgotten 6 hours after your last action;
privacy.sound: whether you turned the sound off;
privacy.server: The server caches film information for 30 days to speed up later loads. This cache holds no personal data.
